modules.name: bearing_constraint_gen

ports.name: done_o
ports.description: Upper constraint and operation completion pulse

ports.name: constraint_upper_o
ports.description: Zero for lower boundary and one for upper boundary

ports.name: constant_c_o
ports.description: Signed half-plane constant with 46 fractional bits

behavior: Capture one Q16.16 sensor position and one 18-bit measured bearing on an idle start.
Form lower and upper phases with modulo-2^18 subtraction and addition of 732 phase LSB.
Invoke cordic_sincos for the lower boundary and then for the upper boundary.
Emit the lower tuple a=-sin(lower), b=cos(lower), c=a*x+b*y before the upper tuple a=sin(upper), b=-cos(upper), c=a*x+b*y.
Time-share one registered signed 32 by 32 DSP multiplier across the four coordinate products.
Assert lower valid 25 cycles after acceptance and upper valid with done 45 cycles after acceptance.
constraints: Coefficients are signed Q2.30 and coordinates are signed Q16.16.
Each coefficient-coordinate product is signed 64-bit; the sum is sign-extended to 66 bits with 46 fractional bits.
The embedded CORDIC interface is the T06 19-cycle contract.
corner_cases: Phase arithmetic wraps naturally across zero and one full turn.
A repeated start while busy raises one protocol error pulse and does not overwrite the observation.
The two constraint valid pulses are ordered lower then upper.
verification_cases: Check cardinal measured bearings at an origin sensor.
Check both sides of a 0-degree wrap with nonzero signed sensor coordinates.
Match four observations from the T02 geometry integration scenario.
Check fixed 25-cycle lower and 45-cycle completion latency and busy-start rejection.

timing_diagrams.title: Lower and upper constraint generation
timing_diagrams.description: One accepted observation produces ordered lower and upper constraint pulses; done accompanies the upper pulse.
